question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing striker, Bob is playing goalkeeper, and Claire is playing left midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Finally, Bob and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) striker
(B) goalkeeper
(C) left midfielder
solution:
Positions in each row are ordered by player: Alice | Bob | Claire.
Initial: striker | goalkeeper | left midfielder
1. Bob ↔ Alice: goalkeeper | striker | left midfielder
2. Claire ↔ Alice: left midfielder | striker | goalkeeper
3. Bob ↔ Alice: striker | left midfielder | goalkeeper
Claire is playing goalkeeper, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
